text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The reporters asked, "Is the second crown 
next?" I replied, "I'm taking on the Mile 
Championship rotation!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The mortal realm rages with controversy 
like the battle goddess's ravens! Just 
like the primordial chaos where light and 
darkness split! Meanwhile, my 
comrade-in-arms is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Offering up their souls for the bloody 
battle. Heh. If I am a magnificent steed, 
then you, too, are a true hero.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And thus, the die was cast! Now, across 
the river of resolve and on to the NHK 
Mile Cup!
